title: 3BR Rosemary Beach, FL Home with Access to the Cabana Pool
meta_description: Stay at Piccadilly Cottage, a 3BR, 4BA Rosemary Beach vacation home, with private beach access, a gourmet kitchen, a bunk room, and 4 bikes. Sleeps 8.
description_expanded: DescriptionWelcome to your exquisitely curated coastal haven — a sophisticated blend of luxury, comfort, and effortless beachside living, nestled just a short stroll or leisurely bike ride from the sugar-white sands of Rosemary Beach.Step through the front door into sunlit interiors where coastal elegance meets refined design. The open-concept living space is adorned with designer furnishings, warm wood accents, and curated textures that create a relaxed, upscale atmosphere. The main living area seamlessly connects to a gourmet chef’s kitchen, with premium appliances, expansive dual countertops, and a stylish breakfast bar — the perfect setting for morning espressos or sunset cocktails.Outdoor Living, ElevatedStep outside into your private courtyard oasis — a serene sanctuary surrounded by lush landscaping. Dine al fresco under the stars, gather around the cozy outdoor fireplace, or lounge on the wraparound porch while soaking in the warm Florida sun. Every corner is designed for unforgettable moments, from sunrise coffee on the balcony to evenings under twinkling string lights.Thoughtful Layout & Designer Touches Across Three LevelsFirst Floor:- Full bathroom with walk-in shower and convenient exterior entry for post-beach rinses- Spacious laundry area- Gourmet kitchen, dining area with seating for eight, and breakfast bar with seating for three- Plush living room with ample seating and Smart TV — ideal for cozy movie nightsSecond Floor:- Cozy seating nook on the landing- Primary King Suite with custom built-in storage, a work desk, private balcony, and a fully remodeled en suite bath featuring an oversized walk-in shower- Secondary King Suite with private balcony and en suite bath offering a combination tub and showerThird Floor:- Cozy lounge area with plush seating and large flat-screen TV- Custom built-in bunk room with two twin-over-full beds — perfect for families or kids- Recently renovated full bathroom with dual vanities, walk-in shower, and private water closetProperty Highlights:- Sleeps 8 comfortably with two king suites and a third-floor bunk room- Four luxurious full bathrooms for ultimate comfort and privacy- Fully stocked chef’s kitchen with high-end appliances and abundant prep space- Smart TV & Sonos sound system for an immersive entertainment experience- Sonos sound system integrated throughout each bedroom- 4 complimentary cruiser bikes — explore Rosemary Beach with ease- Quick access to the Cabana Pool and Rosemary’s vibrant town square- Just a 9-minute walk or 3-minute bike ride to the pristine, private beach- Complete clean bedding program- Electric Vehicle Charger (Level 2 Universal EV Charger (J1772). Tesla owners, please bring your own standard J1772 adapter.Guests also enjoy access to four resort-style pools, private beach entrances, tennis courts, a children’s playground, and boutique shopping and dining — all within the exclusive Rosemary Beach community.The Piccadilly Cottage also has a separate Piccadilly Carriage House that can be rented in tandem with the Cottage at a 25% discount.Where Relaxation Meets Refinement - Whether you’re sipping coffee on a balcony overlooking Kingston Park or enjoying a sunset ride through cobblestone streets, this elegant beach home invites you to relax, recharge, and reconnect. Every detail — from plush bedding to luxurious bath amenities — is thoughtfully curated to offer a five-star vacation experience in one of Florida’s most coveted coastal destinations.
